title: Load balancer shows members offline
problem: Load balancer is not forwarding traffic to backend VMs.
symptoms: Pool members show as inactive in health check
cause: Health check monitors are failing because the backend application is listening on a different port or the security group blocks the health check traffic.
solution: Verify the application is running on backend VMs.
Check security group rules to ensure traffic from the load balancer subnet is allowed.
Verify health monitor path and port settings.
